title: Add a navigation counter to Documents
body: - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chrome * … - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * This is not tested directly, as the counter is not directly web-exposed. However, it enables the tests for a number of performance APIs: * [performance-timeline/back-forward-cache-restoration.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/back-forward-cache-restoration.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-detached-frame.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-detached-frame.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-long-task-task-attribution.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-long-task-task-attribution.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-mark-measure.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-mark-measure.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-element-timing.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-element-timing.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-resource-timing.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-resource-timing.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-initial-load.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-initial-load.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * [performance-timeline/navigation-id-reset.tentative.html](https://wpt.fyi/results/performance-timeline/navigation-id-reset.tentative.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) -
